The K-47 was Techtronika’s answer to Militech’s Ajax. Intended to be superior in every way, all the Moscow engineers managed was a rifle that’s mostly functional, shockingly modular, and appalling to fashion moguls.

Cost: 750eb (Expensive)

Class: Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Assault Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 4 • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: Has 1 additional Attachment Slot (4 Total). If worn openly, this weapon incurs a -2 penalty to Wardrobe and Style Checks.

Range: Assault Rifle
Alt. fire: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
